test_title: PYST 45: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held on 9 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate idiom from the following options that can substitute the underlined part of the given sentence.

It is his first interview, so he has __a nervous feeling__.
solution:
The correct answer is **Butterflies in his stomach.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The question is that he has his first interview and he is **nervous** because of this.
 
• **"A nervous feeling"** means he is **anxious** or he is feeling **worry**.
 
• Among the given four options, **"****Butterflies in his stomach" **means An idiomatic term that describes feeling worried and uneasy in the stomach is **"to get/have butterflies in your stomach."**

 ***Example : **The boy used to get butterflies in my stomach before every examinations.​*

 
• The first option intends to the meaning of **nervous feeling**.

So, **the correct answer** is Butterflies in his stomach .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• When a more severe punishment is called for, it is not appropriate to give a small punishment to someone-that means **"slap on the wrist" .**
 
• **"Tug at his heartstrings"** means to deeply move someone's compassion or anguish for someone or something .
 
• Something added that improves a good thing means **"****Icing on the cake"**.
 
• The above three terms does not match with the **"nervous feeling"** idiom.So there are not the correct options.
